decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (14-136-01; 14-136-02; 14-136-03; 114-136-04; 14-136-05; 14-136-06; 14-136-07; 14-136-08; 14-136-10 (received 02/09/2014 ) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - Before the first beneficial occupation of the development, details of cycle parking shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority and the spaces shown on the approved drawing shall be available for use before first occupation of the development and thereafter maintained and retained as such.

Condition : 4 - The premises shall be used for the purposes set out in the 'Planning Statement Incorporating Transport Statement' dated August 2014 by Planning Potential and for no other purpose (including any other purpose in Class D1.of the Schedule to the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987, or in any provision equivalent to that Class in any statutory instrument revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification).
Condition : 5 - The use hereby permitted for community centre  purposes shall not be carried on outside the following times 7.00am until 12midnight.

Condition : 6 - The use of the premises as a community centre (Use Class D1) hereby permitted shall be  discontinued and the premises returned to its former use as offices ( Class B1) on or before 12th January 2018.
description: Change of use of the ground floor from B1 (offices) to D1 (non-residential institution) for a temporary period of three years.
